scope: Streaming and screen-recording apps under $HOME: OBS Studio, Streamlabs Desktop, Twitch Studio residual, Elgato Stream Deck/Camera Hub/Wave Link caches and logs, Ecamm Live, mmhmm, Loom residual, Riverside, Descript, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve residual extras, ScreenFlow, Camtasia, Snagit, CleanShot residual, Kap, Gifox, LICEcap, QuickTime residual, FaceTime/Photo Booth caches, Continuity Camera. Never wipe project recordings as default; Media/library/project folders are report_only.
safety_notes: Never auto-delete finished recordings, project media, or user libraries. Report-only for Movies/Documents media destinations, OBS/Streamlabs/Ecamm/Loom/Riverside/Descript/CapCut/ScreenFlow/Camtasia project or Media folders, Snagit Library captures, Photo Booth Library, and CapCut drafts.
OBS: clean logs/crashes/profiler/browser GPU caches only. Leave basic.ini, global.ini, scene collections, profiles, and plugins installed under Application Support/obs-studio.
Streamlabs: clean Chromium Cache/Code Cache/GPUCache/logs/Crashpad only under slobs-client. Leave SceneCollections, Service, and user prefs.
Elgato Stream Deck: clean Caches and Logs only. Never wipe Plugins, ProfilesV2, or Backup (user deck layouts).
Elgato Wave Link / Camera Hub: logs and regenerable caches only; leave audio routing prefs and device settings plists alone as wipe targets.
Snagit Library and Autosaved Captures hold user content: report_only. Temporary recording folders under Group Containers may be cleaned when aged.
ScreenFlow Global Library and .screenflow document media are user projects: report_only. Only net.telestream.screenflow* Caches are cleanable.
Camtasia TechSmith project packages and /Users/Shared/TechSmith media: report_only for project trees; app Caches/HTTPStorages cleanable.
DaVinci: this batch adds container Lite caches/logs residual only. Project DB and Gallery remain report_only (see batch 04).
FaceTime: never delete Application Support/FaceTime/*.sqlite*; only Containers/.../Caches and VideoConference caches.
Photo Booth: never delete Pictures/Photo Booth Library; caches only.
CleanShot: residual Sentry/Application Support cache only; never default screenshot save destination.
Loom residual: Chromium caches/logs only; not user video library/exports.
Twitch Studio discontinued residual: caches/logs only if leftover; whole app support may hold scenes report carefully.
sources: Local host: ~/Library/Application Support/obs-studio (plugins present), FaceTime App Support DB, PhotoBooth/QuickTime/FaceTime containers, com.apple.VideoConference cache, DaVinciResolveLite container Caches/Logs

Homebrew cask zap trash: obs, streamlabs, elgato-stream-deck, elgato-camera-hub, elgato-wave-link, ecamm-live, mmhmm, loom, descript, capcut, camtasia, snagit, screenflow, cleanshot, kap, gifox, licecap
Elgato Stream Deck SDK logging docs: ~/Library/Logs/ElgatoStreamDeck/
Elgato Stream Deck support: Application Support/com.elgato.StreamDeck (Plugins/Backup paths documented)
Telestream ScreenFlow support: Caches folders net.telestream.screenflow*
TechSmith Snagit Mac Temporary Recording Location (Group Containers .../Temporary)
Descript uninstall help: ~/Library/Application Support/Descript + com.descript.beachcube caches
Batch 04 creative DaVinci paths (extra residual only here); batch 05 Loom/CleanShot base (residual extras here); batch 07 QuickTime base (residual here)
